newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says trade disputes on Clinton visit agenda.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says trade disputes on Clinton visit agenda.

text.p: U.S.-Mexico trade disputes will be on the agenda for talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton on his official visit to Mexico on May 5, Mexico's Trade Minister Herminio Blanco told reporters on Tuesday.
"There are some very important phytosanitary issues regarding wheat from Baja California, regarding pork from Sonora, we expect to make progress on that," Blanco said.
Blanco said that trade disputes "account for a small percentage of our trade." (( --Veronica Galan, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9553))
